name: kenji-05
situation: Findings, wrong NLP analogy, evidence strength, review (same moves as kenji-01, ablated baseline)
reading_goal: Explore potential use in my research
research_context: I am a PhD student in NLP moving into HCI. My project studies how non-expert users write prompts for LLM-based tools, and I plan to run a user study.
moves: Ask what the main findings of the paper are.
Make a wrong analogy as your own understanding: the participants in the study are like a test set for evaluating the tool.
Refer to 'the probe' with a short reference and ask what it is.
Ask how many participants there were and how the data were analysed.

moves.instruction: Choose a verdict that differs from PaperLens's suggestion, with your own reason.
